notes:
disagreement: shape of the case 1 assignment: one pass tests the group and the assignee in one requirement, the other in two; chose two, one requirement per thing asked (the group is stated, the assignee implied), with the same cells and the same original in each source
The acting user, Jose Roberson (user 32), is an admin whose account is inactive in the seed; the policy has the assistant act with admin responsibilities by default and names no rule barring an inactive requester, so the request is treated as carried out.
Case 1 is critical and already carries both active critical SLA definitions (response 1 and resolution 6, as case SLAs 1 and 2), and no other definition applies to critical priority, so 'attached correctly' is read as those two rows staying attached to case 1 and aligned (stage in_progress) as the case moves to work in progress; no listed tool creates case SLA rows.
'Verify case update' is one conjunction over group, assignee and state, carried jointly by the three case requirements.
